weapons._comment: Weapon geometry and weapon sets. Edit freely: nothing in the code depends on specific clips. 'axis' is the blade direction in the bone's local frame, 'roll' spins the model around that axis (degrees), 'offset' moves the grip point in the bone's local frame (metres), 'grip' is the distance from the fist back to the pommel. Calibrate with the sliders in the app (Nastavenia -> Kalibrácia zbraní) and press 'Uložiť kalibráciu'. Defaults were MEASURED on the Quaternius rig: the fingers of every armed clip flex about the hand's local Z axis (82 deg fist), the thumb/index side is +Z (the blade leaves the fist there), the palm faces local -X and the centre of the fist is ~[-0.028, 0.095, 0]; the shield sits on the dorsal side of the left forearm (local -X).

reference._comment: Hand/forearm frames of the built-in character (KQ.anatomicalFrames, bone-local). 'props' are calibrated in these bones; another character gets them moved into its own bones (KQ.propsForRig).
